chapter: Porch interview and Jazz Train plans
title: How jazz evolved from ragtime
summary: Johnson explains that jazz melded many kinds of music out of ragtime in the 1930s, and that he enjoyed swing as a listener.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: See if you can fill a rather ignorant kid in on what jazz is, what it was and what you were involved in and what it did in that era.
